senses.example: Mi abuela hace unas magdalenas buenísimas.
senses.exampleGloss: My grandmother makes really good little sponge cakes.

alternatives.reason: Affectionate Peninsular form many families use; informal and warm.
Diminutive, common in LatAm and also affectionate in Spain but less usual.

notes: magdalenas are the Peninsular little sponge cakes; the example is a real home-baking scene.
